meta.name: add-dashboard
meta.description: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw. Installs @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard and a pusher that sends periodic JSON snapshots.

copy.tagline: 添加 NanoClaw 监控仪表板，定期推送数据快照。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你管理 NanoClaw 并希望实时观测其状态。
copy.tagline_en: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw and stream periodic data snapshots.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage a NanoClaw instance and want to watch its metrics on a dashboard.

howto.what: 为 NanoClaw 项目添加本地监控仪表盘：安装 npm 包，新增推送器，定期向仪表盘发送数据，网页展示概览、会话、消息等，并支持实时日志。
howto.when: 用户要求为 NanoClaw 添加监控仪表盘、安装监控面板等类似意图时触发。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 添加监控仪表盘
say.note: 开始安装并接线仪表盘组件。

say.text: 配置 DASHBOARD_SECRET 和端口，启动面板
say.note: 设置环境变量并让面板生效。

say.text: 运行构建和测试确认仪表盘已接入
say.note: 验证依赖和代码改动是否正确。

howto.what_en: Adds a local monitoring dashboard to a NanoClaw project: installs the npm package, adds a pusher that periodically sends data, and serves a web UI showing overview, sessions, messages, users, etc., with real-time logs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add a monitoring dashboard or panel to NanoClaw.

say_en.text: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: It installs and wires the dashboard.

say_en.text: Set DASHBOARD_SECRET and the port, then start the dashboard.
Run the build and tests to confirm the dashboard is wired.
